title: Build tight-binding model and Hartree-Fock solver
action: Implement the tight-binding Hamiltonian for Y2Ir2O7 (111) films with indirect and direct hopping (t_s=-t, t_p=-2t_s/3), intrinsic spin-orbit coupling λ (0.2-0.7 eV), and on-site Hubbard U. Construct the TKT trilayer and bilayer geometries and restrict to the j=1/2 manifold. Develop a self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean-field solver.
description: Implementation and verification of the model and solver; not scored.

title: TKT trilayer phase diagram
action: For the TKT trilayer geometry, run self-consistent Hartree-Fock for a range of U/t (e.g., 0 to 6 in steps of 0.5). At each U/t, identify the phase (M, I, TI, MC, MI, CI) and compute the Chern number. Write results to step_01_tkt_phase_diagram.csv.
description: Phase diagram data for the TKT trilayer.
output_schema: columns: U_t (float), phase (string, see description), Chern_number (int)

title: Bilayer phase diagram
action: For the bilayer geometry, run self-consistent Hartree-Fock for a range of U/t (0 to 6). Determine the phase and compute the Z2 invariant. Write results to step_02_bilayer_phase_diagram.csv.
description: Phase diagram data for the (111) bilayer.
output_schema: columns: U_t (float), phase (string, see description), Z2_invariant (int, 0 or 1)
